title: Ex10 - Code: Relplot transaction data
text:
Using the transaction dataset, plot weekly sales for products 'f_15' and 'f_22' using sns.relplot(). Use x='week', y='sales', hue='product_id', size='discount'.

The merged dataframe is available as weeklydemand_df with columns: week, product_id, discount, price, sales.
answer:
sns.relplot(x='week', y='sales', hue='product_id', size='discount',
    data=weeklydemand_df[(weeklydemand_df['product_id']=='f_15') | (weeklydemand_df['product_id']=='f_22')],
    sizes=(40, 300), alpha=.5, palette='muted', height=9)
